integrity: Automorphism groups and pushforward formulas are derived directly. The source coalgebra formulas are independently checked against the Leibniz coalgebra and bialgebra compatibility identities over five finite fields, and all finite-field orbit formulas are exhaustively replayed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies base changes of the two induced coalgebra families displayed in the source tables, not all triangular Leibniz bialgebras over arbitrary fields.
The quotient forgets the choice of r-matrix witness and classifies the induced Leibniz bialgebra structure.
No completeness claim is made for all finite-field triangular Leibniz bialgebras.
title: Square and cube classes in the two-dimensional triangular Leibniz bialgebra moduli
